DIRECTOR OF SHAPE OF WATER: GUILLERMO DEL TORO
“I’VE HAD THIS MOVIE CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON IN MY HEAD SINCE I WAS 6, NOT AS A STORY BUT AS AN IDEA (FOR SHAPE OF THE WATER
. WHEN I SAW THE SWIMMING SCENE WITH JULIE ADAMS, I THOUGHT THREE THINGS:
‘HUBBA-HUBBA.’
‘THIS IS THE MOST POETIC THING I’LL EVER SEE.’ I WAS OVERWHELMED BY THE BEAUTY.
‘I HOPE THEY END UP TOGETHER.’”
N THE SEVEN YEAR ITCH, MARILYN MONROE’S CHARACTER IS TALKING ABOUT THE SADNESS IN THE MOVIE THE CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON.
